Welcome to the University of Sunderland! With 27,500 students across campuses in the North East, London, Hong Kong, and 15 partner countries, we’re a global community of tomorrow-makers. Ranked Top 40 in The Guardian University Guide 2025, we’re all about world-class research, real-world impact, and unforgettable student experiences.

Explore life at Sunderland — and don’t forget to subscribe. See you on campus!
